text:
sara: heads up — we have the private/VPC airgap handoff to customer ACME scheduled for tomorrow 03:00 UTC. packaging job is green. need quick sign-off on artifact pin strategy + rollback criteria before i trigger the transport. :ship:

deploy-bot: scheduling packaging pipeline at 02:30 UTC. will produce the sealed bundle and cosign signatures. will tag: `installer-acme-v1.4.9+acme-20260322`. artifacts: installer.tar.gz, runtime-images.tar.lz4, submanifest.json, cosign.sig

tom: quick Q — are we using sha256-only pins for the submanifest? last time they requested both sha256 + short tag for offline ops.

kiran: prefer sha256 in manifest and keep tag label for human ops. offline handoff checklist requires: cosign sig, sha256 in submanifest, signed manifest TTL=30d, and offline signer attestation.

mike: release notes drafted — calling out: 'pin runtime image set to rset-20260322; default quantization profile: q4_1; canary disabled for private delivery; post-install healthcheck script included.'

ops-qa: acceptance tests to run after install (on-customer-net): `smoke.sh`, `kv-restore-check`, `console-auth-check`. If any smoke.sh fails we consider rollback. define thresholds?

sara: rollback criteria proposal: 1) installer checksum mismatch on target (fail fast) 2) post-install smoke.sh failure OR >10% gateway 5xx across first 10 minutes OR KMS attestation failure. If triggered, we halt and push pinned previous bundle `installer-acme-v1.4.8` and run evac script.

deploy-bot: packaging output preview:
```
artifact: installer-acme-v1.4.9+acme-20260322.tar.gz
sha256: 3a7f8b9e2d4c1f9aa1b2c3d4e5f6a7b8c9d0e1f2a3b4c5d6e7f8a9b0c1d2e3f
cosign: cosign.sig (key-id: projects/acme-kms/keys/packaging-signer)
submanifest.managed: rset-20260322
```

kiran: note — our offline signer will not expose KMS. we hand off cosign.sig (detached) + signer-attestation.pdf via courier. ops on-site to verify sig and checksum before unseal. add step in release notes.

tom: timeline check — packaging 02:30, courier pickup window 04:00-06:00 UTC, customer ETA for ingest 08:00 UTC. that gives ~4h ops window. we should include a forced hold at 06:30 UTC to allow manual abort.

mike: add to release notes and change window doc: forced-hold command for deploy-bot: `/deploy hold installer-acme-v1.4.9 --until 06:30` and abort: `/deploy abort installer-acme-v1.4.9 --reason "postpack failing"`

ops-qa: please also publish a minimal rollback playbook inside the bundle at `docs/rollback.md`. include commands: `./evac.sh --tag installer-acme-v1.4.8` and contact matrix.

sara: agreed. i'm going to: 1) add sha256 to submanifest 2) ensure cosign detached sig and signer attestation included 3) add hold at 06:30 4) include rollback.md in bundle. planning to kick packaging in 20m unless anyone objects. :white_check_mark:

tom: no objections from me. :thumbsup:

kiran: ok from security side. confirming offline key rotation doc included.

deploy-bot: packaging queued. will post job URL and final checksums when done. /deploy triggered by sara at 02:30 UTC.

sara: thanks — i'll ping ops channel when courier is picked up and paste the sealed manifest here once packaging completes.

mike: note for postmortem — tag the ticket `private-delivery` and include transit chain-of-custody.

ops-qa: adding acceptance checklist to release notes now. will stand by for artifacts. :mag:
